children: Overview
Canada gold royalty firm's Q3 revenue rose 13% yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 rose yr/yr but missed analyst expectations
Company says higher gold and oil prices drove revenue and earnings growth
Outlook
Franco-Nevada sees 2026 GEOs sold between 525,000 and 555,000
Company expects 2026 diversified revenue of $300 mln to $330 mln
Franco-Nevada tracking toward mid-range of annual guidance for 2026
Result Drivers
HIGHER GOLD AND OIL PRICES - Co said stronger gold and oil prices drove revenue and earnings growth

LOWER GOLD STREAM DELIVERIES - Co said GEOs sold fell due to lower contributions from gold stream segment and iron ore assets, partly offset by higher energy asset contributions and favorable silver-to-gold conversion
ASSET-SPECIFIC PRODUCTION ISSUES - Co cited lower deliveries or production at Cobre Panamá, Guadalupe-Palmarejo, Antapaccay, and Candelaria as weighing on precious metal GEOs sold
